searchText: **JonnyRhea** Fyi: Max # of validators = `MAX_VALIDATORS_PER_COMMITTEE` * `MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT` * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH = 2^11 * 2^6 * 2^5 = 2^22 thanks @dannyryan As discussed on the last eth2 call, we will be doing a networking specific call. The first of these will be on Dec 4th at 1pm UTC The tentative agenda can be found here -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/106 If you are currently working on a (non-client dev) networking related task, please add it in a comment below This is less of a general status update call and more of a working group to complete more targeted items. Please send the 1 or 2 members of your team who have the most expertise or familiarity with p2p networking and the eth2 specific neworking related issues **ajsutton** When writing a BeaconBlocksByRoot request (https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/v0.9.2/specs/networking/p2p-interface.md#beaconblocksbyroot) it’s written as a field, not a container. Does that mean the list length is omitted or not? e.g. if there’s only one block being requested is the request data just that block’s hash (so 32 bytes long)?

excerpts.content:
**JonnyRhea**
Fyi:  Max # of validators =  `MAX_VALIDATORS_PER_COMMITTEE` * `MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT` * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH = 2^11 * 2^6 * 2^5 = 2^22
thanks @dannyryan
